summary: Shared always-on service exists and the CLI submission paths delegate to it.

findings.message: Added `packages/coding-agent/src/always-on/service.ts` with `createAlwaysOnService()`, `readSnapshot()`, and primitive `submit(...)` variants for immediate, once, recurring, and follow_up submissions.
Refactored `packages/coding-agent/src/always-on/cli.ts` so the `send`, `schedule`, and `follow-up` command paths now delegate to the shared service instead of owning unique orchestration logic.
The new contract is covered by `packages/coding-agent/test/always-on-service.red.test.ts`, and adjacent always-on tests remain green.
